artworks.title: Thus the Master Pulls the Cow out of the Well by its Tail
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people observing cattle. A group of individuals, some standing and some seated, are gathered near a tranquil setting with a few cows. The scene is shaded by lush trees and the sky above is dotted with subtle clouds.

artworks.title: Adam and Eve
artworks.description: The image shows two figures engaged in an interaction. One figure is seated with legs extended, leaning back on one arm, reaching out with the other to receive an object. The other figure is perched on a rock, leaning slightly forward to offer the object. Both figures have distinct features and are unclothed. In the background, there is a landscape with additional figures, animals, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image shows three adults and two cherubs. A central seated female figure is draped in robes, with a small child on her lap. An adult male figure stands beside her. One cherub is flying above them, while another is alongside. The background features a pastoral setting with trees and sky.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman holding an infant, with a man standing beside her. The woman has a headscarf and long garment, while the man has a beard and is dressed in a cloak. Two cherubs or angels appear in the background, holding a drapery. The setting includes trees, a landscape, and clouds.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image displays three figures and an angel as the main subjects. The angel, with large wings, stands in the center, reaching up towards palm fronds. Two individuals are portrayed beside the angel, one seated and looking upwards, the other lying down, partially covered, with the third figure facing the viewer. The figures are depicted in classical attire, surrounded by a lush landscape and a sky with clouds.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angel and three figures in a pastoral setting. The drawing features a central winged figure standing and gesturing amidst trees. Around the angel, there are three other figures, two sitting and one reclining. Their clothing appears to be flowing and draped, with intricate lines indicating the texture and folds. In the background, there are trees and a suggestion of a natural, serene environment. The composition is detailed with precise line work capturing an ethereal and timeless quality.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image is an etching of three figures seated together. A woman and an older man are shown from the knees up, sitting closely on a blanket under a tree. The woman holds a small child, who appears to be asleep on her lap, wrapped in part of her garment. The older man beside her has a beard and curly hair. He is dressed in loose, flowing robes, with a draped outer garment, and leans slightly towards the woman, his arm wrapped around her. Next to the trio is a donkey grazing on the grass. The background shows a pastoral scene with additional trees, rolling hills, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image shows figures in a natural setting. There are various people gathered in a lush foliage-filled landscape. In the center, an adult figure holds a child on their lap, while another older figure seems to be conversing nearby. On the left, an angelic figure with wings raises their arms towards a palm tree. The background features detailed depictions of tree branches and clouds in the sky. The image is intricately drawn with fine lines.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image shows three figures outdoors. In the center, a woman holds an infant in her lap, while a man sits to the right of them near a tree. The background features a landscape with trees and hills, and detailed line work and clouds add depth to the scene.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, with a focus on their upper and middle bodies. The person on the left is sitting upright, facing slightly towards the viewer, with their head turned to the side and down, holding a child. This figure has delicate facial features and long hair covered by a shawl. They wear flowing garments. The second person on the right is seated, leaning with their elbow on their knee, holding their head in their hand. The background depicts a natural setting with textured trees, bushes, and hills or mountains. The scene is rendered with fine, detailed lines.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image features an etching of two people shown from head to toe. The figure on the left is a woman seated on the ground, while the other figure, likely a man, also sits on the ground. The woman is looking down at a bundle she holds in her hands. She wears a long dress and styled hair. The man appears to be engaged in reading or examining an object. He has a shaved or closely cropped head and wears a tunic-like garment. The background includes suggestions of trees or foliage.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.description: The artwork depicts four human figures, two males and two females, seated. One woman holds a baby, while one man holds a young child. The figures have different hairstyles and clothing, sitting in a natural setting with trees and hills in the background. The scene is drawn in a sketch-like style, focusing on lines and expressions.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.description: The image is a line drawing showing four individuals outdoors. Two adults and two children are depicted, with some seated. The adult on the left has long hair and is holding a young child on her lap. The adult in the center interacts with the other child, while the adult on the right is holding the second child. The setting includes trees, rolling hills, and mountains in the distance. The drawing is signed "C. Rensu in. et fec."

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of four individuals, two adults, and two children. The main adult is sitting with a child on each knee. This person is wearing a hooded cloak with soft facial features. The children have curly hair and are reaching towards each other. The second adult is seated behind them, wearing a loose robe and appears to be holding something, possibly a book. The background features trees, bushes, foliage, and a calm sky.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.description: There is an image of a woman and child seated, along with two other figures. The woman is on the left, seated with visible upper body. She has styled hair gathered at the top and delicate facial features turned slightly toward the child in front of her. She wears a long garment that goes down to her feet. The child, nude, stands on the woman's lap, touching her face with both hands. Another child leans over her shoulder and a bearded man is seated to their right, propping his head on his hand. The children have soft curls in their hair, while the man's hair and beard are more rugged. The background is minimal, with an architectural element on the far left suggesting a column and lines indicating drapery around the figures. The image appears to be a sketch or an engraving, using line work to define the figures and their clothing.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of three people: a baby, a woman seated and holding the baby, and an older man behind them. The baby, woman, and man are positioned as described. The setting includes a background with vertical lines and a small plant or flower pot visible on the right side behind the woman. The woman is holding the child's hands, and the child seems to be holding a string of beads. The composition emphasizes the intimate interaction among the subjects.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman holding a small child, with another person standing behind them. The woman is seated with the child on her lap, her head slightly tilted towards the child. She has delicate facial features and her hair is styled up, with a soft wave around her face. She is wearing a long, flowing dress with detailed folds, and her feet are visible peeking out from beneath her garment. The child is unclothed and the two of them create an interaction. The person standing behind them has their arms raised, holding or adjusting a fabric canopy forming a backdrop. The background features a rough cityscape sketched with faint lines. The figure behind has less detailed facial features with short hair, wearing a long-sleeved garment. The texture of the fabric and the intricate lines of the etching contribute to the composition's classic, timeless quality.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child with Saint John
artworks.description: The image includes four figures: three adults and one child, captured in a half-body view. The central adult figure is seated and holding a baby. The seated figure has a head covering, draped clothing, visible eyes, and a beard. Beside them is an elderly man with short hair and a beard leaning slightly forward. On the left side, the child, an infant, appears to be supported by the seated figure. The child is partially unclothed with short curly hair. In the background, there is an architectural element resembling a pillar and drapery hangs above the figures. The scene is depicted in a detailed, linear style with intricate hatching and shading.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child with Saint John
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals, with a central figure holding a child on their lap. An elderly man observes the child, while a third adult interacts with the child by holding its hand. The child is nestled against the central figure's shoulder. The people are shown from the waist up, wearing draped clothing with intricate folds. The background includes a curtain and an architectural element resembling a column on the right. The image is a black and white etching with detailed linework.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman holding a child on her lap. The woman is in a relaxed position, with her head tilted downward to the child who is standing on her lap. The woman has closed eyes and shoulder-length hair. She is wearing a long robe. The child is unclothed with curly hair and one arm around the woman's neck. Both the woman and the child have a halo around their heads, depicted by radiant lines. There are several cherubic figures with curly hair on the left and in the clouds below. The background is filled with clouds.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child
artworks.description: The image shows the upper bodies of a woman and a baby seated together against a backdrop of clouds and cherubic figures. The woman is wearing draped clothing and embraces the baby. Her facial features are delicate, with wavy hair framed by radiant lines. The baby is surrounded by similar rays and faces to the right. Three cherubic figures float in the clouds around them. The background consists of clouds and light shading, creating a divine atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child with a Bird
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing the upper half of a woman seated, with a full view of a child lying across her lap. The woman is positioned in a gentle incline, with her head resting on her left hand, looking down at the child. Her facial features depict a serene expression, and her hair is covered with a cloth. She is clad in a flowing robe that drapes around her body and the child, creating a sense of continuity between them. Her right arm supports the infant, who is naked and appears to be reaching upwards. In the background, there is a curtain to the right, and above her head, the etching shows a circular aura. A bird is depicted in the upper left corner, seemingly tethered with a long line. The surrounding ambiance is minimal, with etched lines providing texture and depth.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child with a Bird
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman with an infant in her arms. The woman cradles the child closely, leaning in towards them. She has soft facial features, a serene expression, and hair tied back under a cloth. She wears long, flowing robes and sits beside a curtain between pillars. A bird flies in the sky above her. There is a light hatching effect creating a halo-like shape around her head. The composition emphasizes the connection between the woman and child.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a woman and a child. The woman is seated with her upper body visible, holding the child close to her. Both figures are facing slightly to the right, with the woman looking down at the child. She has gentle facial features and her hair is styled with soft waves or curls, partially covered by a cloth or veil. The woman is draped in flowing garments. The child is sitting on her lap or supported by her arm, with curly hair visible. The background is filled with wispy clouds. Circular halos with radiating lines are depicted around the heads of both figures.
